gload.label: G-load in flight
gload.notMeasuredTitle: No g-load for this flight: recorded before this version and without a stored track.
gload.title: Highest and lowest g-load in the air – without pauses, slew and time acceleration and without the {window} around each touchdown (they count as the landing's g). Moving average over {smoothing}, so single spikes do not count.
gload.counts: Above {high}: {highCount} ×, below {low}: {lowCount} × (each at least {min} in a row)
gload.sourceLive: Source: live from the telemetry stream.
gload.sourceTrack: Source: from the track, 1 Hz – derived afterwards; shorter peaks are missing, pauses only recognised by the frozen position.

hint.high: G-load in flight up to {g} ({phase}, {alt}) – well above the 1 g of straight and level flight (hard pull, turn, turbulence){source}
hint.highWarn: G-load in flight up to {g} ({phase}, {alt}) – close to the limit load factor of an airliner (+2.5 g){source}
hint.low: G-load in flight down to {g} ({phase}, {alt}) – strongly unloaded (level-off, push-over, turbulence){source}
hint.lowWarn: Negative g-load in flight: {g} ({phase}, {alt}) – airliners are only designed for −1 g{source}

live.label: Max g so far
live.title: Highest g-load in the air so far (touchdowns excluded, averaged over {smoothing}; the last {window} follow once it is clear no touchdown follows)
